description: This file contains implementation code for a trigger simulator in a vehicle engine management system. It includes classes and functions for simulating trigger signal events, checking signal usefulness, and managing trigger shape synchronization during simulation.

classes.name: TriggerStimulatorHelper
classes.description: Helper class to simulate trigger events and manage trigger shape synchronization during engine simulation.

methods.name: feedSimulatedEvent
methods.description: Feeds a simulated trigger event, updating the trigger state based on the shape and current index.

methods.name: assertSyncPositionAndSetDutyCycle
methods.description: Validates trigger shape definition by feeding multiple cycles and calculates expected duty cycles.

methods.name: findTriggerSyncPoint
methods.description: Finds the trigger synchronization point index within the shape during simulation.
